questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged in the following equation to make it correct?

5 × 15 ÷ 7 - 20 + 4 = 77
questions.solution:
Given equation: 5 × 15 ÷ 7 - 20 + 4 = 77

Interchanging signs: (÷ and +)

5 × 15 + 7 – 20 ÷ 4

According to BODMAS rule.

5 × 15 + 7 – 20 ÷ 4

= 5 × 15 + 7 – 5

= 82 - 5

= **77**

Hence, after interchanging (÷ and +) the equation becomes correct.

For,

questions.question:
Two statements are given followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

No ball is pen. All pens are boxes.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some boxes are pens.

II. Some boxes are balls.

III. No box is ball.

options.text: Conclusion I and either II or III follows
Either conclusion II or III follows

questions.solution:
The least possible venn diagram is as shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3efd01b4f17c23a0a8f31eb41ada9a1e72289f7c2620691ae1eca7eb125df4d.png] 

**Conclusion:**

1) Some boxes are Pens – True (All pens are boxes)

2) Some boxes are balls – False (it is possible but not definite)

3) No box is ball – False (it is possible but not definite)

Here, conclusions II and III form a complementary pair.

Hence, only conclusion I and either II or III follows.

questions.question:
Select the number that will come next in the following series.

2, 6, 14, 30, 62, ?
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

2 = 2 × 2 + 2 = 6

6 = 6 × 2 + 2 = 14

14 = 14 × 2 + 2 = 30

30 = 30 × 2 + 2 = 62

62 = 62 × 2 + 2 = **126**

Hence, the next number will be 126.

questions.solution:

(6, 6² = 36, 36² = 1296­­)

Hence, the set (3, 9, 81) is related to the set (6, 36, 1296).

questions.question:
Three of the following four numbers are alike in a certain way and one is different.

Pick the number that is different from the rest.
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

3 + 2 + 3 = 8

3 + 5 + 3 = 11

3 + 1 + 3 = 7

3 + 7 + 3 = 13

Here, 11, 7 and 13 are prime numbers.

Hence, 8 is the odd one among the alternatives.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following set.

(3, 5, 34)
questions.solution:
The pattern followed here is:

3² = 9 and 5² = 25; 9 + 25 = 34

Similarly,

4² = 16 and 7² = 49; 16 + 49 = 65

Hence, the set (4, 7, 65) is related to the set (3, 5, 34).

questions.question:
Vikarm is twice as old as his brother Ajay. 5 years ago, Vikram was 3 times as old as Ajay.

How old is Vikram now?
questions.solution:
Vikram = 2 (Ajay) …..(i)

Five years ago,

Vikram - 5 = 3(Ajay - 5)

Vikram - 5 = 3 (Ajay) - 15 

Therefore, Vikram = 3 (Ajay) - 15 + 5 = 3 (Ajay) - 10 …..(iI)

From (i) and (ii),

3 (Ajay) - 10 = 2 (Ajay)

⇒ 3 (Ajay) - 2 (Ajay) = 10

⇒ Ajay = 10

Therfore, Ajay's present age = 10 years.

Now, Vikram's present age = 2 × Ajay's present age 

Hence, Vikram is 20 years old now.

questions.question:
Three different positions of the same dice are shown. Which alphabet will appear on the opposite surface on which alphabet P appears?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bf78f07612cc710f47632eaf79226262bf9a16faa2b8469d9952a4cc8d0ce16d.png]
questions.solution:
From the 2nd and 3rd positions, we notice that Z, T, P, and X are adjacent to S.

Therefore, Z should be opposite to either one among T, P, and X.

Now, from position 1, we know that Z is adjacent to X. Also, from position 2, it can be seen that Z is adjacent to T.

Therefore, Z must be on the face opposite to that of P.

Hence, Z will appear on the opposite surface on which alphabet P appears.

questions.question: Rohit's age is 10 years less than half of his mother's age who is 5 years younger than Rohit's father. If Rohit's father is 47 years old, what is Rohit's age?
questions.solution:
Let's Rohit's age be x.

According to the given information, x = 1/2 × (mother's age) - 10

⇒ x + 10 = 1/2 × (mother's age)

⇒ Therefore, mother's age = 2 × (x + 10) = 2x + 20.

Also, father's age = mother's age + 5 = 2x + 20 + 5 = 2x + 25.

Given that father's age = 47 years.

Therefore, 2x + 25 = 47

⇒ 2x = 47 - 25 = 22

⇒ x = 22 ÷ 2 = 11.

Hence, Rohit's age is 11 years.
